Demonstrate deorbiting method with Shape Memory Alloy based sail.
Description

Develop an inexpensive and reliable method of satellite deorbitation by using an expandable structure - SMA (Shape Memory Alloy) based sail.

Failure cause Problems with the satellite's energy balance and hardware issue with communication module.
